# deploy-inputs.txt: every path Cloudflare Pages' build reads (npm ci, then node tools/build.mjs dist), as git
# pathspecs, one a line. post-deploy.yml reads it: the live site serves the newest main commit that touched one
# of these (with build watch paths set, Pages builds no other commit). Cloudflare's build watch paths are the same
# list (Settings > Build > Build watch paths): include site/*, src/*, then each file as written here; exclude
# nothing. deploy-inputs.mjs --check (validate.yml) fails if build.mjs comes to load a tool not listed here.
site
src
tools/build.mjs
tools/minify.mjs
tools/parts.mjs
tools/glslmin.mjs
tools/plan.mjs
package.json
package-lock.json
.gitattributes
